title: Mall World spinoff dreams?
content: **Does anyone here have reoccurring dream locations that you (somehow) know when you’re in it that this isn’t a ‘Mall World’ place it doesn’t quite feel the same.** But it’s almost like a spinoff series of Mall World locations, that I often visit - often years apart. These extra locations, I seem to remember are almost exclusively nothing like places in waking life, which is different from my Mall World dreams. Those places are usually completely different still from waking life - BUT I often can ‘feel’ similarities to real locations. For example my ‘Big City’ I feel like is similar to London…but different. The extra locations seem to be very strange (more than normal) there is always an extremely complex history to the places, like Mall World. Often with surreal cultures, races, time travel, deeply layered storylines. Sometimes I go into this amazing game.
